tasks.task: Ensure Nginx is installed.
Ensure Git is installed.
Install curl using the currently available package version, then hold that installed version so that future package-index updates — including newer curl releases — do not upgrade it.
Ensure unzip is installed.
Ensure Apache2 is absent.
Ensure the directory /opt/myapp exists.

Ensure /etc/myapp/app.conf contains the following configuration block, creating the file if it does not exist and preserving all other existing content:
setting1=value1
setting2=value2
Ensure /opt/myapp/app.conf has permission mode 0644.
Ensure /opt/myapp/current is a symbolic link pointing to releases/v2.
Ensure the line APP_MODE=production exists in /etc/myapp/app.conf.
Ensure the user appuser exists.
Ensure the group appgroup exists.
Ensure appuser is a member of appgroup.

Ensure appuser's SSH authorized_keys file contains exactly the following key, replacing any previously configured key:
ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAITestKeyForResearchOnly appuser@test
Ensure /opt/myapp is owned by appuser:appgroup.
Ensure Nginx is running.
Ensure Nginx is enabled to start at boot.
Ensure Nginx is stopped.
Ensure the Nginx worker_connections value in /etc/nginx/nginx.conf is set to 1024 and Nginx is restarted only when the configuration changes.
Ensure cron is installed and the cron service is running.
Ensure the environment variable APP_ENV=production persists across reboots and shell sessions.
Ensure the Nginx worker_connections value in /etc/nginx/nginx.conf is changed from 768 to 1024.
Ensure /etc/nginx/conf.d/myapp.conf contains exactly: server { listen 8080; server_name localhost; location / { return 200 'myapp'; } }
Ensure a daily cron job exists at 02:00 to run /usr/local/bin/myapp-backup.sh, with exactly one such job configured.
Ensure the system timezone is set to Etc/UTC.
Ensure /etc/hosts contains the mapping 127.0.0.1 myapp.local exactly once.
Ensure /usr/local/bin/setup-myapp.sh is executed only when /var/lib/myapp/setup.done does not exist, and that the marker file exists after successful setup.
Ensure the directory /opt/demo-data exists.
Ensure the contents of /tmp/myapp.tar.gz are extracted into /opt/app.
Ensure /var/lib/myapp/deployment_record.txt contains a deployment timestamp when first created, while preserving an existing deployment record unchanged.
